maria_csops: Heads-up — I noticed ~120 accounts this morning where duplicate contact merges caused playbook automation to fire twice. Some customers got duplicate enablement invites and a renewal risk flag. Not great :grimacing:

jon_engineer: Oof. Do you have an example account id? Is this only after the nightly merge job?

maria_csops: Example: acct_48921. Merge happened at 03:12, playbook run started at 03:13 and again at 03:14 because both pre-merge records kept separate playbook keys. I think the dedupe job marks the canonical id but we don't suppress playbook triggers for suppressed records.

sam_csm: Seeing this affect 3 enterprise trials — they got two onboarding invites and one escalation. Customers are confused. We should stop automation while we patch, or add suppression at the playbook layer. 

jon_engineer: Agreed. Short-term stop: we can gate playbook runner to ignore records with `dedupe_pending = true` or `merge_ts` within last 5 minutes. Long-term: add a dedupe suppression flag emitted by the merge pipeline.

eli_data: I can add the suppression flag. Proposal: add `cs_dedupe_suppressed` boolean on contact row, set true during merge window, clear after canonicalization completes. Then playbook SQL should join and filter `WHERE cs_dedupe_suppressed = false OR cs_dedupe_suppressed IS NULL`.

eli_data: Quick metrics query to find impact:
```sql
SELECT count(*) AS affected_count,
       sum(case when playbook_triggered then 1 else 0 end) AS triggers
FROM contacts c
LEFT JOIN playbook_runs p ON p.contact_id = c.id
WHERE merge_ts BETWEEN now() - interval '1 hour' AND now()
  AND c.cs_dedupe_suppressed IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE;
```

jon_engineer: That SQL looks good. For immediate mitigation I can add a short-circuit in the runner: if contact.merge_ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' then skip. That buys us time for the flag rollout. I'll also add a metric `playbook.skipped_due_to_merge` so we can track skips.

maria_csops: Sounds good. Risk: skipping might delay a legitimate critical alert (renewal risk). Can we make the rule: skip non-urgent playbooks only? e.g., skip `onboarding_email` and `enablement_invite` but run `renewal_risk` or `legal_escalation` always.

jon_engineer: Yep — runner already classifies playbooks by severity. I'll implement skip for severity <= 2.

eli_data: Timeline: I can push the suppression flag to staging tonight (ET). Migration script to backfill for last 30 days will be a separate job and marked low priority.

sam_csm: Who owns notifying the affected customers and reconciling duplicates we accidentally emailed? I can draft an apology template and a small follow-up credit for the trials.

maria_csops: Sam — please do the template. Ops — opsbot, can we schedule a brief maintenance notice in #general for the downtime window?

opsbot: @maria_csops scheduled: "Brief playbook automation maintenance" today 23:45-00:05 UTC — announcement will post 10 minutes prior. :white_check_mark:

jon_engineer: Plan of action: (1) Short-circuit runner by severity (jon) — deploy in 15m, monitor metrics. (2) Add `cs_dedupe_suppressed` flag (eli) — rollout to staging tonight, prod tomorrow AM. (3) Backfill script for last 30 days (eli) — run after prod flag is live. (4) Customer comms (sam) — draft and share. (5) Instrument metrics and add alert if skipped_triggers > 50 in 10m (jon+eli).

maria_csops: I'll own the post-mortem and add to tomorrow's CS weekly. Also will tag any high-value accounts affected and escalate to AMs.

sam_csm: Draft ready, posting in this thread shortly for review.

jon_engineer: Deploying short-circuit now. Watching logs: `playbook.runner: skip contact acct_48921 severity=1 merge_ts_recent` — working.

opsbot: deploy-bot: successfully deployed playbook-runner v2.3.7 by jon_engineer at 2145678948

eli_data: Staging flag pushed at 2145678955. I added migration `update contacts set cs_dedupe_suppressed = true where merge_ts > now() - interval '1 hour';` for testing only. Will NOT run in prod until after sign-off.

maria_csops: Thanks all. Please update the action items in Asana and mark owners. We'll reconvene if skips > 100 in the next hour. :thumbsup:
